controls.label: Monochrome
controls.description: Galileo clear-filter images mapped onto the measured 60 × 40 × 34 km reference ellipsoid. Relative image brightness is normalized with a bounded photometric approximation. Finest sampling is about 3 km/pixel; other views are coarser. Gray grid marks unavailable or unreliable imagery. This is not a resolved terrain model or calibrated albedo.
